title: Duty
description: Who is on duty right now, time served, the full log and leaves of absence. Every deletion, forced clock-out and export is logged (here and on Discord).
adminOnlyText: Viewing, deleting and exporting duty time is only available to the server's administrators (or owner).
openSessions: {count, plural, one {# open shift} other {# open shifts}}
exportDoneText: Logged on the website and on Discord.
nobodyOnDuty: Nobody is on duty right now
forceOutText: Their time so far counts. The bot logs it on Discord too.
forceOutAllText: {count, plural, one {# member is} other {# members are}} clocked out; their time so far counts.
resetAllText: Every counter of every member becomes 0. The log stays. This can't be undone.
purgeAllText: Counters AND the log are deleted. This can't be undone.
resetOneText: Every type's counter becomes 0; the log stays.
purgeOneText: The counters and the member's log entries are deleted.
loaHint: Decide here, on Discord with the request's buttons, or with /szolgalat loa dontes — the member gets the decision (and reason) in a DM.

server.adminOnly: Only the server's administrator can do this (deleting and viewing duty time).
server.noData: There is no data to export yet.

payHint: Pay: the time shown × hourly wage
loaDenyReason: Reason for denial (optional) — the member gets it in a DM
